mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand expansion that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate profits and capital investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicates strong residential construction activity that supports consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 238.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates policy uncertainty that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 238.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.
